probe.text_sample: Future Being Skip to main content [Info] Future Being is a studio dedicated to nurturing ideas and sharing resources that support the healing of our planet and the safeguarding of biological and cultural diversity. Our work encompasses grants, storytelling, events, and collaborations. Rather than accepting unsolicited proposals, our grants are offered through relationships that grow organically within our community and ecosystem.
